<USER_QUERY>
Uttar Pradesh districts along the Jharkhand border
</USER_QUERY>

WITH a AS
    (SELECT geometry
     FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
     WHERE id = 'a4b4695b-082b-47da-ab92-b0ea969368fe'),
     n AS
    (SELECT geometry
     FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
     WHERE id = '0d78d47c-2c3f-4416-84ab-cdff87b9ef71')
SELECT b.id,
       b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.subtype,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS b,
     a,
     n
WHERE b.subtype = 'county'
    AND ST_Within(b.geometry, a.geometry)
    AND ST_Touches(b.geometry, n.geometry)
